title: Totalization preserves the open tensor unit equation
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories with countable coproducts, E:A→B and R:B→A additive adjoints, and F and G additive bifunctors on A and B. Suppose the sheaf comparison γ:G(EM,N)≅E(F(M,RN)) has adjoint transpose F(η_M,id) followed by the inverse of the specified restriction isomorphism ρ:R(G(M,N))≅F(RM,RN). Suppose total complex comparisons Γ and Ρ have the prescribed homogeneous summand formulas for γ and ρ. Then for every pair of unbounded cochain complexes P,T, F_total(η_P,id) followed by Ρ_(EP,T)^(-1) and R_complex(Γ_(P,T)) equals the termwise adjunction unit at F_total(P,RT).

source.place: Lemma lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor, totalization and adjoint transpose of its natural comparison

proof.text: Equality of chain maps is detected in every degree. The coproduct insertions of the homogeneous (p,q) summands jointly detect maps out of a tensor total, including the zero and unbounded cases.

Postcompose the restriction summand identity with its inverse. It states that the tensor insertion followed by the inverse total restriction equals the inverse sheaf restriction followed by R of the original insertion.
Write the sheaf transpose using the adjunction unit and postcompose with R(γ.hom). Cancellation of γ.inv followed by γ.hom gives F(η,id) followed by ρ.inv and R(γ.hom) equal to η at F(M,RN).

Move F_total(η,id) through a homogeneous insertion by bifunctor naturality; substitute the inverse restriction summand identity and then the Γ summand identity. The preceding sheaf equation leaves η followed by R(E(insertion)). Naturality of η identifies this with insertion followed by the termwise unit. Joint detection finishes.

lean.statement:
theorem openTensorUnitTotalization
    (sheafGamma : ∀ M N, (G.obj (E.obj M)).obj N ≅ E.obj ((F.obj M).obj (R.obj N)))
    (sheafRestriction : ∀ M N, R.obj ((G.obj M).obj N) ≅
      (F.obj (R.obj M)).obj (R.obj N))
    (hsheaf : ∀ M N, adj.homEquiv _ _ (sheafGamma M N).inv =
      (F.map (adj.unit.app M)).app (R.obj N) ≫
        (sheafRestriction (E.obj M) N).inv)
    (totalGamma : ∀ P T,
      (G.map₂CochainComplex.obj
          ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).obj T ≅
        (E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((F.map₂CochainComplex.obj P).obj ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T)))
    (totalRestriction : ∀ P T,
      (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj ((G.map₂CochainComplex.obj P).obj T) ≅
      (F.map₂CochainComplex.obj ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).obj
        ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T))
    (hgamma : ∀ P T (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n),
      HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
          ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) T G (.up ℤ) p q n h ≫
        (totalGamma P T).hom.f n =
      (sheafGamma (P.X p) (T.X q)).hom ≫ E.map
        (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P
          ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T) F (.up ℤ) p q n h))
    (hrho : ∀ P T (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n),
      R.map (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P T G (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫
          (totalRestriction P T).hom.f n =
        (sheafRestriction (P.X p) (T.X q)).hom ≫
          HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
            ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T) F (.up ℤ) p q n h)
    (P : CochainComplex A ℤ) (T : CochainComplex B ℤ) :
    (F.map₂CochainComplex.map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app P)).app
        ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T) ≫
      (totalRestriction ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) T).inv ≫
      (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (totalGamma P T).hom =
    (adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app
      ((F.map₂CochainComplex.obj P).obj ((R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T))
